count_flops_for_convolution: use conv_flop_jit to count floating point operations for a JIT-traced convolution layer
count_flops_for_linear_layer: use addmm_flop_jit to count floating point operations for a fully connected linear layer
count_flops_for_batch_norm: use batchnorm_flop_jit to count floating point operations for a batch normalization layer
count_activations_for_op: use generic_activation_jit to create a handle that counts activations from an operation output shape
count_flops_for_matmul: use matmul_flop_jit to count floating point operations for a matrix multiplication operation
